FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Sarah Thompson - Lead Designer, Elegant Spaces Interior Design, 555-123-4567, sarah@elegantspacesdesign.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Elegant Spaces Interior Design, we specialize in creating personalized, aesthetically pleasing interior environments for residential clients. Our operations encompass comprehensive design consultations, where we assess clients' needs and preferences to curate unique decor solutions. We focus exclusively on design elements, such as space planning, color selection, and furniture arrangement, ensuring that all services comply with local regulations. Our team maintains strict adherence to documentation protocols, including formal contracts and comprehensive project records, ensuring clarity and accountability throughout each engagement. We prioritize protecting client information through secure digital storage practices and robust cybersecurity measures. Our services are designed to enhance the beauty and functionality of homes, delivered with the utmost professionalism and attention to detail.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: In September 2022, a client reported damages to their property during a fabric installation project due to adhesive residue affecting their hardwood floors. The estimated loss was $2,000. The claim was settled in October 2022, with the amount reimbursed fully by the insurance.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B Safe with UL Ratings; Residential grade, certified for secure storage of sensitive documents and valuables.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installation and on-site monitoring by licensed personnel.
